incbot: INCIDENT PAGE — streaming decode p99 spike in us-west-2 detected by alerting (p99 > 2.1s, p95 ~ 480ms). Auto-pager sent to #eng-oncall :rotating_light: <https://internal/alerts/INC-1719804321>
Jordan: getting paged. seeing large tail for streaming endpoints, customer-facing RPCs show stalls. Rolling window started ~08:04 UTC.
Michelle: confirmed. dashboard shows deploy of kernel/runtime image `rt-2026-03-14-trt8-flashattn` rolled out 02:00 UTC to canary then prod. rollouts show bump in decode median and long tail since ~07:58.
Samir: quick grep from node logs — heavy compilepath churn and page eviction warnings:
```
[2026-03-14T07:58:12Z] WARN compilepath: evicting kernel cache key=trt8-flashattn, duration=320ms
[2026-03-14T07:58:13Z] ERROR decode: KV pagefault while filling cache for shard=us-west-2-a token_idx=1024
[2026-03-14T07:58:14Z] WARN runtime: high-latency decode kernel compile-time=1.2s
```
Lee: sounds like compilepath regressions + flashattn kernel variant causing tail stalls and page churn. Impacting streaming more because of realtime JIT/compile paths.
Carmen: customer impact: support already triaged 3 PRO accounts reporting playback stalls; estimating ~1.8% of production sessions seeing stall > 1s. Not yet SLA breach but trending.
Jordan: can we route traffic off the new kernel variant quickly? fallback routing policy exists (`runtime.routing.kernel_fallback=true`). Suggest flip to older kernel pool and throttle canary traffic.
Michelle: agree. Samir — can you run a soft rollback (route to `rt-2026-02-20-trt7` image) or apply runtime flag to disable flashattn backend?
Samir: on it. Command I'm running:
```
# switch routing for streaming-prod to fallback kernel pool
redwoodctl routing set --service streaming-prod --policy kernel_preference=stable_only --rollout manual
```
Samir: also flipped `runtime.config.disable_flashattn=true` on us-west-2 for streaming-prod.
deploy-bot: ACTION: start rollout change  -> change-id=rb-1719804321-routing, user=Samir
deploy-bot: change rb-1719804321-routing: applying to 18 nodes in us-west-2. expected completion ~2m
Jordan: monitoring metrics. p95 dropping already from 480ms -> 220ms, p99 moving from 2100ms -> 380ms after partial cutover :eyes:
Michelle: good. leave canary disabled until we confirm no more tail regressions. also open PR to gate the trt8 flashattn variant behind a better compile cache warmup.
Samir: logs after routing change show much lower compile churn; pagefault warnings decreased.
```
[2026-03-14T08:06:18Z] INFO compilepath: cache hit rate=87% after fallback
[2026-03-14T08:06:20Z] INFO runtime: avg decode latency p95=210ms p99=365ms
```
Carmen: I'll update support and CS with a short blurb: "We observed a transient decode latency regression after a runtime kernel variant rollout. We've routed impacted traffic to a stable kernel. We're monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem." cc: @accounts-eng
Jordan: next steps before handoff to SRE:
- Confirm full rollback or persistent routing change (Samir)
- Collect compilepath flamegraphs and kernel build IDs for triage (Michelle)
- Run a small synthetic streaming load to validate (Lee)
- Create incident ticket and link customer reports (Carmen)
Samir: routing change completed — rb-1719804321-routing done. p99 stable at ~370ms now. leaving a temporary pin on stable kernels.
Michelle: capturing compile artifacts now and will push to /artifacts/incident/1719804321. early hypothesis: new kernel's JIT path interacts poorly with our continuous-batching compilepath and causes repeated recompile for streaming shapes.
Lee: running synthetic load now — 10k concurrent short-stream sessions. monitoring for memory pressure and page churn.
Lee: synthetic looks clean; no spikes and tail stabilized. will keep the test running for 30m.
Carmen: created incident ticket INC-1719804321 with customer notes and severity tracking. tagging sales/success for affected accounts.
Jordan: good work. handoff: I'll leave this with SRE for full postmortem and followups. On-call until 09:30 UTC; if anything regresses ping me.
incbot: Incident auto-update: status=mitigated, mitigation_action=route-to-stable-kernel, owner=SRE-team, incident_link=<https://internal/incidents/INC-1719804321>
Michelle: flagging action items for follow-up PM/infra retro:
- Add pre-merge perf gates for kernel variants (unit + streaming shape evals)
- Improve rollout ramp heuristics for compile-heavy kernels
- Add alert to detect sudden increase in compilepath evictions
Samir: noted. I'll attach the logs and steps in the incident ticket.
Jordan: handoff complete. leaving a short summary in the ticket and will follow up on the postmortem. :thumbsup:
